Nora (CS): Weekly SummitAI health check. TL;DR: overall usage steady, embed cost up, noticed p99 regressions on /completion non-stream yesterday afternoon. Sharing p95/p99 by route+model and streaming vs non-streaming.

Ben (Infra): dropping numbers please. Any particular spike window?

Nora (CS): Rolling 7-day window. p95/p99 in ms, error %, daily requests.

```
route        model      mode         p95  p99   err%  req/day
/chat        t5-pro     streaming    260  820   0.2%  21k
/chat        t5-pro     non-stream   460 1450  1.2%   3k
/completion  gpt-mini   sync         720 2000  2.3%   5k
/embed       nano       streaming     50  140  0.03%  58k
/rerank      llama2     non-stream   1100 3100  3.8%   700
```

Omar (SRE): rerank tail looks correlated with large batch sizes and a retry storm at 03:18 UTC. Any logs from the dedicated pool?

Nora (CS): Yes Omar, customer uses dedicated for rerank. We saw 5 OOM events in the dedicated pool yesterday. We throttled batch size to 1k tokens at 23:45 and that dropped OOMs.

Priya (Customer): We had one user-facing timeout at 15:10 that caused our client to fallback and re-request. Small but visible.

Ben (Infra): For /chat, streaming reduces p95 ~40% and tightens p99. Recommend enabling streaming by default for chat endpoints. Also suggest enabling prefix caching for repeated system prompts.

Nora (CS): Action items:
- Omar: gather dedicated pool OOM logs and link ticket by EOD (@Omar).
- Ben: propose default streaming flag for chat in our onboarding template.
- Nora: send updated cost snapshot and cap options for embed to Priya.

AlertBot: Created ticket CH-2426-77 assigned to Omar \'SummitAI dedicated pool OOMs\'.

Ben (Infra): Quick snippet for switching to streaming:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"/chat","model":"t5-pro","stream":true}'
```

Priya (Customer): I'll flip streaming on in staging tonight and report any regressions. Also please include the embed budget cap options.

Nora (CS): Noted 1. Next sync Wednesday 11am PT. Thanks all!
